verdict.rationale: Dots is built around natural-language operation: you talk to an always-on agent and can keep talking while it works. You can reach it by typed chat or voice call in ChatGPT, by DM or @mention in Slack, or in Teams. Plain-language requests drive scheduled, recurring work (e.g. 'Check the connected planning channel each weekday at 9 AM…'), routing preferences, bug investigation, and even control rules, where you simply describe the action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably the natural-language commands are interpreted.
